prediction: Current-epoch raster-prefix BN statistics including the complete T=10 Y values of the current spatial packet; prediction is then frozen before encoding that packet. No future packet or true final threshold is used by the predictor.
arithmetic: NumPy float64 mathematical replay of archived binary source and exact-SHA checkpoint parameters. This is not the frozen PyTorch float32 operator order or a hardware number format.
reference: Independently compute BN then fullrank PSN in float64; also count mismatches against archived FC2 binary input.
costs: Report packet failure, union across T for each output h, union across fixed 96-output-lane groups, source-activity-weighted FC1 recomputation terms, PSN recomputation terms and bare payload sizes. No cycle, energy or accuracy admission.
scope: One predefined sample, two predefined layers, all rows and output channels. No GPU, training, new capture or EDA. Preserve result; no rerun to select favorable samples.
